question:
Study the below graph carefully and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bbd6f9217d7bbb1b43543d036d1e366cecdf78a83862254f3489281798c8a80.png] 

What is the percentage increase in the price of Diesel from April to July (rounded off to one digit after decimal)?
solution:
**Given:**

Price of Diesel in April = ₹7,150 per metric tonne

Price of Diesel in July = ₹13,500 per metric tonne

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = frac{{(Final Value - Initial Value)}}{{Initial Value}} times 100\%

**Calculation:**

Initial price (April) = ₹7,150

Final price (July) = ₹13,500

Increase in price = 13,500 - 7,150 = ₹6,350

Percentage increase = (6,350)/(7,150) times 
100\%

⇒ Percentage increase = (635)/(715) times 100\%

⇒ Percentage increase ≈ 0.888111... × 100%

⇒ Percentage increase ≈ 88.8%

**∴ The percentage increase in the price of Diesel from April to July is approximately 88.8%.**
